questions.prompt: Which conditions do seeds need to germinate? Choose all that apply.
questions.explain: Seeds use stored food, so light and soil aren't needed to germinate.

questions.prompt: In the Germination Lab, seeds kept under boiled, cooled water did not germinate. Why was the water boiled first?
options: To remove dissolved air, so the seeds had no oxygen
questions.explain: This tests whether seeds need air.

questions.prompt: A seedling grown in a dark cupboard is tall, thin and pale yellow. What does this tell you?
options: Seeds can germinate without light, but the seedling needs light to become green and healthy
questions.explain: Chlorophyll forms in light; the seedling stretched looking for light.

questions.prompt: Plan a fair test to find out whether bean seeds need water to germinate.
questions.modelAnswer: Set up two identical dishes with cotton wool and five bean seeds each. Dish A (the control): moisten the cotton with water. Dish B: keep the cotton dry. Keep both in the same warm place, with the same light, for the same time. Count the seeds that germinate in each dish each day for a week. Only the water is changed, so any difference is due to water. Using five seeds per dish makes the result more reliable.
rubric: Two set-ups differing only in water
Same temperature, light, seed type and number
Measure: number germinated over time; several seeds
questions.explain: Criterion B: change one variable only.

questions.prompt: Order the life cycle of a frog.
steps: Tadpole with a tail and gills
questions.explain: This big change in body form is called metamorphosis.

questions.prompt: Order the life cycle of a mosquito.
questions.explain: All the early stages need still water, which is why removing stagnant water prevents dengue and malaria.

questions.prompt: 20 bean seeds were set up in the control dish and 17 germinated. What percentage germinated?

questions.text: When a seed starts to grow into a new plant, it is called ___. Before this, a seed is resting, or ___.
questions.explain: Dormant seeds can last a long time.
